_doc: Hidden territory deposits: 2 treasures (one-time reward: gold, Reroll Tokens, optionally a Special Die) and 2 mines (income in gold every round for a limited number of rounds, optionally a Reroll Token every token_every payouts) per continent, each continent with its own names and numbers. Each one lies on a RANDOM territory tile of the whole board (never on a monster lair) and is never drawn on the map: a player finds it only by landing there. A treasure is gone for everyone once found; a mine belongs to whoever found it (see DepositSystem).

aetherion.name: Buried Royal Tithe
aetherion.lore: A tax chest the old kings hid before the last war.

aetherion.name: Crown Jeweler's Cache
aetherion.lore: Gems sewn into a collapsed workshop wall.

aetherion.name: Sunstone Quarry
aetherion.lore: Golden stone that the Sunmarch masons forgot.

aetherion.name: Emerald Seam
aetherion.lore: A green vein running under the Vale roots.

arcanum.name: Forgotten Grimoire Vault
arcanum.lore: A sealed vault of spellbooks, worth more than their weight in gold.

arcanum.name: Mana Crystal Hoard
arcanum.lore: Condensed mana, humming softly inside a cracked lens.

arcanum.name: Aether Crystal Mine
arcanum.lore: Crystals that regrow overnight if you leave the roots.

arcanum.name: Umbral Ink Wells
arcanum.lore: Black ink the scribes of the Vault pay dearly for.

machina.name: Scrap Baron's Stash
machina.lore: A rusted safe packed with coin and bearings.

machina.name: Prototype Cache
machina.lore: Unfinished inventions, sold to the first bidder.

machina.name: Ironvein Shaft

machina.name: Voltaic Ore Pit
machina.lore: Sparking ore that pays fast and burns out fast.

sylvaris.name: Druid's Seed Hoard
sylvaris.lore: Rare seeds and a purse left by a vanished druid.

sylvaris.name: Heartwood Hollow

sylvaris.name: Amberwood Tap
sylvaris.lore: Amber sap tapped from trees older than the Dominion.

sylvaris.name: Moonroot Mine
sylvaris.lore: A slow, patient mine below the Terra Roots.

drakmor.name: Dragon's Hoard
drakmor.lore: Gold the wyrm never came back to guard.

drakmor.name: Warlord's War Chest
drakmor.lore: A war chest and a trophy die from the Pits.

drakmor.name: Obsidian Pit

drakmor.name: Brimstone Deep
drakmor.lore: Sulfur and ore from the belly of the Hellforge.

thalassia.name: Sunken Galleon
thalassia.lore: A galleon that settled on the shoals, hold still full.

thalassia.name: Pearl Reef Cache

thalassia.name: Salt Pan Works
thalassia.lore: Slow but dependable salt pans on the strait.

thalassia.name: Black Pearl Beds
thalassia.lore: Rare beds in the Trench that pay in bursts.

eclipsia.name: Frozen-Hour Vault

eclipsia.name: Paradox Strongbox
eclipsia.lore: A box that was already open before you found it.

eclipsia.name: Starfall Seam
eclipsia.lore: Fallen star metal buried in the Solstice dials.

eclipsia.name: Echo Ore Lode
eclipsia.lore: Ore that is mined again every time it is mined.
